summary: Comprehensive backend + frontend testing of Pianificatore Viaggio. All 14 backend API tests passed (CRUD, validation 422, 404 handling, waypoint stripping, search across all fields, duplicate '(copia)'). All frontend flows passed: form fill, waypoint add/reorder/remove, mode selection (aria-checked), transit warning, Google Maps URL build with correct params/order, map preview iframe, save dialog + persistence, current-trip-label, search, duplicate, delete w/ confirmation, reset, GPS button renders. ONE real design/CSS bug found: on mobile (390px) the action bar is NOT pinned to the bottom of the viewport due to a transform on an ancestor .fade-up section creating a containing block for the position:fixed element.

ui_bugs.issue: On mobile viewport (390x844), the fixed action bar is NOT anchored to the viewport bottom. Measurement: position:fixed, bottom:0px, but rect.bottom=629 (winH=844, 215px gap). Root cause: the <section> wrapping ActionBar has class 'fade-up' which runs a transform keyframe animation with animation-fill-mode: forwards; the final computed transform ends up as matrix(1,0,0,1,0,0) (identity) instead of 'none'. Per CSS spec, any transform other than 'none' creates a containing block for position:fixed descendants, so the ActionBar is pinned to the bottom of that section rather than the viewport. This fails the requirement 'Mobile 390px: action bar is fixed to bottom of viewport'.

issues: Two separate @keyframes fadeUp blocks defined (lines 6-11 and 13-18); the second overrides the first entirely. Should be merged into one @keyframes with both from{} and to{} rules so the intended fade+translate animation actually plays.

action_items: Fix mobile action bar bottom-pinning. Easiest fix: remove 'fade-up' from the <section> that contains ActionBar in /app/frontend/src/pages/Planner.jsx (or move <ActionBar> out of the animated section so no transformed ancestor exists). Alternative: change .fade-up animation in /app/frontend/src/App.css to animate only opacity (drop translateY) so the computed transform remains 'none'.
Merge the two @keyframes fadeUp blocks in /app/frontend/src/App.css into a single block containing both from and to rules, otherwise the fade/translate animation does not run as intended.
critical_code_review_comments: App.css: duplicated @keyframes fadeUp – second declaration overrides first; animation currently doesn't actually translate.

The .fade-up animation uses translateY + forwards which creates a transform containing block on the ancestor, breaking any position:fixed descendant (ActionBar). This is a common CSS pitfall; prefer animating opacity only, or scope the animation so it doesn't wrap elements that need viewport-level fixed positioning.
server.py returns 404 for invalid ObjectId strings in to_oid (good), but 'validation' errors (missing name/origin/destination with empty strings) correctly produce 422 via Pydantic min_length. OK.
server.py: duplicate uses TripInput.model_fields set — fine, but Trip.from_mongo serialization relies on serialize() stripping _id via by_alias=False. Verified no '_id' in responses. Good.

For retest focus on mobile ActionBar: at viewport 390x844 after page load, element wrapping [data-testid="btn-open-google-maps"] must have getBoundingClientRect().bottom == window.innerHeight (==844). Verify no ancestor has computed transform other than 'none'.
rca of the issue: mobile fixed action bar: ancestor <section class='... fade-up'> has animation-fill-mode: forwards on a transform keyframe. Even after animation completes, computed transform is matrix(1,0,0,1,0,0) which per CSS spec establishes a new containing block for position:fixed descendants (https://www.w3.org/TR/css-transforms-1/#transform-rendering). The ActionBar's position:fixed therefore anchors to the section's bottom instead of the viewport's bottom. Repro: open app on mobile 390px, observe action bar is in-flow around middle of screen; evaluate getComputedStyle on the section shows transform != 'none'.
